review_context.method: The reviewer read the original source and necessary conventions before all seven catalogues, 216 owned paths and 67 cases. Source/accounting premises, every scalar oracle, minimal controls, input bytes and evidence fingerprints were checked before consulting compiler outcomes. No owned Fortran validity defect was found. The coordinator subsequently repaired the advisory taxonomy and declared-input diagnostic parser and collected fresh observations.

6.4.rationale: All seven paragraphs and the informative note are accounted for. INCLUDE source replacement is distinct from statements/preprocessing; spelling, literal selectors, placement, nested expansion, cycles and boundary restrictions preserve their source premises. Flat ASCII sidecars at the common staged root are a qualified processor interface, not universal filename/search semantics. The adjacent free spelling and numeric-selector interface remain pending.

4.1.1.rationale: Notation and both local note anchors receive source/typography accounting, not artificial Fortran execution effects. No unrelated note, annex or whole-census ratification is inferred.

4.1.2.rationale: Constraint conventions and their distinction from broader textual restrictions are preserved. Explanatory conventions do not themselves require an arbitrary diagnostic program.

4.1.3.rationale: R401-R403 and C401 retain defining ownership here. Finite list/name/scalar controls and the diagnostic witness do not stand in for complete assumed-form, override and associated-constraint use graphs.

4.1.4.rationale: Actual statement and embedded-context conventions retain their conditions. Finite controls do not establish the entire context census or justify blanket R/C invalid twins.

4.1.5.rationale: The local explanatory/informative conventions are classified without turning notes or examples into additional mandatory requirements.

4.2.rationale: All eight paragraphs, ten processor obligations and their qualifications are accounted for. Capability is distinct from one invocation and fatal rejection. The FORMAT exception, compatible extensions, size/complexity, non-Fortran dependencies and processor-dependent provision remain qualified. The should recommendations are classified separately without mandatory or implementation credit. Twenty-four capability/aggregate facets remain pending.

recommendation_classification.resolution: Two base and six fine classification gaps are closed using the source's advisory modality. Every recommendation needs a source rationale and remains part of content-bound catalogue review. Unknown dispositions remain errors. The final definitional sentence of p7 is still definition, not recommendation.
recommendation_classification.future_documentary_assessment: Actual adherence would need qualified, version-bound documentation or other appropriate independent evidence. Source classification alone does not supply it.

included_file_diagnostics.actual_message_basis: GNU explicitly identifies recursive inclusion. For the indirect cycle, the primary location is the closing edge in second.inc even though the message names first.inc as the repeated target.
included_file_diagnostics.resolution: Declared-input file:line:column parsing no longer depends on a compilation suffix. It supports included .inc files, other suffixes and extensionless assets, retains expected relative directory components, and clears include/context attribution before unlocated messages. The unbound legacy location parser is unchanged.
forbidden_substitutions: included-here context instead of primary diagnostic
generic depth exhaustion instead of cycle reporting
included_file_diagnostics.actual_results: Both GNU cycle observations now pass their original source/message contracts. Both LFortran cycle crashes and Flang's generic depth-limit failures remain failures. No source bytes, case IDs, or compiler output were rewritten.

source_only_cases.S6_4_007_invalid__first_fixed: The first noncomment record of the included fixed source is a continuation line, contrary to 6.4 p6. Its minimally repaired boundary is source-valid; no current reference meets the declared included-file/line contract.
source_only_cases.S6_4_007_invalid__first_free: The included free source begins with a prohibited continuation boundary under 6.4 p6. The one-boundary repair is conforming. A host location, driver summary or selected-mode acceptance does not satisfy the included-source oracle.
source_only_cases.S6_4_007_invalid__first_nested: Nested source replacement does not waive the first-noncomment-line restriction for the included inner text. The valid repaired nested expansion is retained; current differently attributed or missing reports are not reference validation.
source_only_cases.S6_4_008_invalid__last_fixed: The last noncomment line of the included fixed text begins a continued statement, prohibited by 6.4 p6. The independent boundary repair is valid. A host/source-search or unrelated failure cannot replace the declared included-file report.
source_only_cases.S6_4_008_invalid__last_free: The included free text ends at a prohibited continued-statement boundary. The source and minimal repair are independently justified; selected reference observations do not meet the included-file/line oracle.
source_only_cases.S6_4_008_invalid__last_nested: The same last-noncomment boundary condition applies through nested replacement. Preserve the source-valid repair and original oracle rather than silently moving attribution to a host or whole-program span.

pending_evidence.include_adjacent_free_spelling: The pin does not explicitly resolve INCLUDE's membership in the separator rule's keyword/name domain. Neither nonstatement status nor uppercase typography proves the answer. No adjacent-free test is credited; a source-based or official interpretation is required.
pending_evidence.include_numeric_kind: A separate KIND('A') profile can qualify a static default-kind-number branch without probing INCLUDE. It is not itself proof of the processor-dependent source-reference interface. Keep static source/payload and an independent result oracle; qualify the remaining interface before removing this pending facet.
pending_evidence.foundation_source_use_graphs: Five facets need content-bound assumed-form/override/constraint/context membership evidence linked to canonical sources and cases. Another arbitrary program cannot close that census.
pending_evidence.foundation_capability_aggregates: Twenty-four facets need declared finite denominators, qualified processor modes/interfaces and actual evidence, retaining failures, skips and unknowns. Completion of a finite inventory is not proof of every possible program.
pending_evidence.conforming_obsolescent_reporting: Needs a reporting contract for conforming input; current diagnose means invalid input and must not be misused.
pending_evidence.advisory_documentation: Recommendations are now classified, but actual adherence has not been assessed.

precision_and_followups: Corrected the INCLUDE ordering references to 5.1/R502 and separately 5.3.2 p1; distinguished 4.2 p6 semantics, p7 limit/extension documentation advice and p8 methods/semantics advice.
Updated the old design Goal so it no longer demands a universal invalid twin and fatal rule-code rejection for every R/C alias or meta-language definition.

The legacy C1302 container mixes exempt character-format cases with a nonexempt FORMAT statement, while retaining its stronger policy basis. Future aggregate evidence must preserve that per-case context.

Legacy argument-kind fixtures need a separate supported-kind qualification review. Their S15.5.2.4 compatibility spelling points to 15.5.2.5, and supported-kind disagreement is not unsupported-kind use. No unreviewed kind repair was made in this batch.

preservation.intentional_whitespace: Scoped INCLUDE .f/.inc attributes preserve independently reviewed fixed-column padding and boundary blank records; they do not alter compiler behavior.
